messages.content: What parameters do the viscous friction force depend on, and in which case should it be taken into account for the physical pendulum model? In your response the last word of each sentence must become the first word of the next sentence.

message.content: The viscous friction force depends on the angular velocity of the pendulum and the coefficient of viscosity, representing the fluid's resistance to motion. The coefficient of viscosity is typically determined by the medium properties, such as the fluid density and the size of the swinging object. It should be taken into account for the physical pendulum model when analyzing systems where energy dissipation due to fluid resistance is significant. Significant energy losses occur in cases where high-precision measurements are required or when studying damped oscillations over extended periods.
